<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

> [!NOTE]
> This description was updated by @ZJY0516's AI agent (Claude Code) after addressing the latest review comments (f5b5b198b0) and merging main (12946cc1be). The original implementation is by @zexplorerhj.

## Overview

Add D-Spark speculative decoding for [Ling 3.0 Flash](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash) using the official [Ling D-Spark draft](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-dspark). The Ling draft is normalized onto the existing Qwen3 D-Spark runtime; no new drafter is added.

## Claims

- `LingDSparkModel` drafts are validated against a `BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM` target and mapped to `Qwen3DSparkModel`. The draft checks shared with Qwen3-Omni D-Spark now live in one helper (`_validate_qwen3_dspark_draft`).
- `BailingMoeV3` exposes the auxiliary hidden states D-Spark needs (`SupportsEagle3`).
- The draft's `block_size` is the default `num_speculative_tokens`; an explicit value still takes precedence.
- On hybrid MLA targets, a DFlash/D-Spark draft whose KV page would exceed the target page uses a smaller KV block that fits the target page, instead of inflating the target's MLA/KDA pages (or failing page-size unification).

## Validation

Unit tests:

```bash
pytest tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dflash_causality.py tests/model_executor/test_bailing_moe_v3.py \
  tests/test_config.py -k "dflash or dspark or bailing or eagle_aux"   # 50 passed
```

E2E on GB200, Ling 3.0 Flash BF16, TP=4, branch head `12946cc1be`. GSM8K: 1319 questions, 5-shot chat completions, thinking off, temperature 0, concurrency 8.

| Configuration | GSM8K flexible / strict | Mean acceptance length | Eval wall time |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Target only | 91.28% / 88.63% | - | 405 s |
| Ling D-Spark (`num_speculative_tokens=7`) | 91.58% / 88.78% | 6.02 | 269 s |

Per-position acceptance for positions 1-7: 93.9 / 86.4 / 79.1 / 71.9 / 64.5 / 57.3 / 49.1%. Eval wall time is a rough end-to-end signal, not a throughput benchmark.

<details>
<summary>Launch command</summary>

```bash
vllm serve inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash \
  --trust-remote-code \
  --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --reasoning-parser ling3 \
  --moe-backend flashinfer_cutlass \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","model":"inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-dspark","num_speculative_tokens":7}'
```

`--moe-backend flashinfer_cutlass` is required on current main for both configurations, and it is unrelated to this PR. The auto-selected FlashInfer TRTLLM BF16 MoE fails in its routing kernel: Ling has 64 experts per group, and the kernel allows at most 32 (one warp).

</details>

CI cannot run the end-to-end path: the Ling checkpoints are registered with `is_available_online=False` because they are too large for CI. The unit tests above cover config normalization, aux hidden-state capture, and the draft KV block size selection.

## Details

**Draft KV block size.** Ling pairs an MLA/KDA hybrid target with a dense MHA draft. The hybrid alignment raises the global block size until the MLA page covers the KDA state, for example 512 tokens at TP=4. At that block size the draft's MHA page is about 3.6x the target page. MLA pages cannot be padded, so page-size unification fails.

`_DFlashAttention.get_kv_cache_spec` now picks the largest block size that meets three conditions:

- it divides the global block size, so the scheduler LCM is unchanged;
- the backend runs it directly, without splitting the block;
- its page fits in the target page (`cache_config.mamba_page_size_padded`).

Unification then pads the draft page up to the target page. For Ling 3.0 Flash this gives 128 tokens at TP=1/2/4/8, with 88.9% of each draft page used. No core KV-cache code is changed.

The E2E engine log confirms the geometry: target block 512, Mamba page padded by 0.70%, and an LCM of 512 across KV cache groups.

The draft's dense MHA KV (32 KV heads) is much larger per token than the target's MLA KV. Adding the draft reduces KV capacity from 13.9M to 3.1M tokens at TP=4. That cost comes from the draft architecture, not from the block size.

**Scope.** Only hybrid MLA targets use this path. Non-MLA hybrid targets with larger DFlash drafts, such as Qwen3.5 + DFlash, keep their current behavior.

**Duplicate check.** There is no other open PR for Ling D-Spark or BailingMoeV3 aux hidden states.

---

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Unit tests for Bailing V3 auxiliary hidden-state outputs."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+
+from vllm.model_executor.models import bailing_moe_v3
+from vllm.model_executor.models.bailing_moe_v3 import (
+    BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM,
+    BailingMoeV3Model,
+)
+
+
+class _AddOneLayer(nn.Module):
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, positions, residual):
+        del positions
+        if residual is None:
+            residual = torch.zeros_like(hidden_states)
+        return hidden_states + 1, residual
+
+
+class _FinalNorm(nn.Module):
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, residual=None):
+        if residual is None:
+            return hidden_states
+        return hidden_states + residual, None
+
+
+def test_bailing_v3_returns_requested_aux_hidden_states(monkeypatch):
+    pp_group = type(
+        "PPGroup",
+        (),
+        {"is_first_rank": True, "is_last_rank": True},
+    )()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(bailing_moe_v3, "get_pp_group", lambda: pp_group)
+
+    inner_model = BailingMoeV3Model.__new__(BailingMoeV3Model)
+    nn.Module.__init__(inner_model)
+    inner_model.start_layer = 0
+    inner_model.end_layer = 3
+    inner_model.layers = nn.ModuleList([_AddOneLayer() for _ in range(3)])
+    inner_model.word_embeddings = nn.Embedding(1, 2)
+    nn.init.zeros_(inner_model.word_embeddings.weight)
+    inner_model.norm = _FinalNorm()
+    inner_model.do_not_compile = True
+
+    model = BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM.__new__(BailingMoeV3ForCausalLM)
+    nn.Module.__init__(model)
+    model.model = inner_model
+    model.set_aux_hidden_state_layers((1, 3))
+
+    hidden_states, aux_hidden_states = model.forward(
+        input_ids=torch.tensor([0]), positions=torch.tensor([0])
+    )
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(hidden_states, torch.full((1, 2), 3.0))
+    assert len(aux_hidden_states) == 2
+    torch.testing.assert_close(aux_hidden_states[0], torch.full((1, 2), 1.0))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(aux_hidden_states[1], torch.full((1, 2), 3.0))
+    assert model.supports_eagle3

     assert get_eagle3_aux_layers_from_config(vllm_config.speculative_config) == tuple(
         layer_ids
     )
+
+
+class _MultipleOf16Backend:
+    @classmethod
+    def get_name(cls):
+        return cls.__name__
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_supported_kernel_block_sizes(cls, kv_cache_spec=None):
+        return [MultipleOf(16)]
+
+
+class _FixedBlockBackend(_MultipleOf16Backend):
+    @classmethod
+    def get_supported_kernel_block_sizes(cls, kv_cache_spec=None):
+        return [16, 32, 64]
+
+
+class _LargeBlockBackend(_MultipleOf16Backend):
+    @classmethod
+    def get_supported_kernel_block_sizes(cls, kv_cache_spec=None):
+        return [256]
+
+
+def _make_attention(backend):
+    attention = _DFlashAttention.__new__(_DFlashAttention)
+    nn.Module.__init__(attention)
+    attention.attn_type = AttentionType.DECODER
+    attention.sliding_window = None
+    attention.kv_cache_dtype = "auto"
+    attention.kv_cache_torch_dtype = torch.bfloat16
+    attention.num_kv_heads = 8
+    attention.head_size = 128
+    attention.head_size_v = 128
+    attention.attn_backend = backend
+    attention.layer_name = "draft"
+    return attention
+
+
+def _make_vllm_config(use_mla: bool):
+    # Ling 3.0 Flash at TP=4: 512-token MLA/KDA target page of 512 * 1152 bytes.
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(block_size=512, mamba_page_size_padded=512 * 1152),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(use_mla=use_mla),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("backend", "use_mla", "expected_block_size"),
+    [
+        (_MultipleOf16Backend, True, 128),
+        (_FixedBlockBackend, True, 64),
+        (_MultipleOf16Backend, False, 512),
+    ],
+)
+def test_dflash_kv_block_fits_hybrid_mla_target_page(
+    backend, use_mla: bool, expected_block_size: int
+):
+    spec = _make_attention(backend).get_kv_cache_spec(_make_vllm_config(use_mla))
+
+    assert spec.block_size == expected_block_size
+
+
+def test_dflash_kv_block_rejects_backend_without_fitting_block():
+    attention = _make_attention(_LargeBlockBackend)
+
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="no kernel block size"):
+        attention.get_kv_cache_spec(_make_vllm_config(use_mla=True))

+def _validate_qwen3_dspark_draft(
+    name: str,
+    draft_hf_config: Any,
+    target_num_layers: int,
+) -> int:
+    """Validate the draft fields shared by standalone Qwen3 DSpark checkpoints.
+
+    Returns the trained block_size.
+    """
+    block_size = _get_qwen3_dspark_value(draft_hf_config, "block_size")
+    if block_size is None:
+        block_size = _get_qwen3_dspark_value(draft_hf_config, "dspark_block_size")
+    if (
+        not isinstance(block_size, int)
+        or isinstance(block_size, bool)
+        or block_size <= 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} requires a positive integer block_size in the draft config."
+        )
+
+    target_layer_ids = _get_nested_config_value(
+        draft_hf_config, "dflash_config", "target_layer_ids"
+    )
+    if target_layer_ids is None:
+        target_layer_ids = getattr(draft_hf_config, "dspark_target_layer_ids", None)
+    if target_layer_ids is None:
+        target_layer_ids = getattr(draft_hf_config, "target_layer_ids", None)
+    if not isinstance(target_layer_ids, (list, tuple)) or not target_layer_ids:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} requires a non-empty target_layer_ids list in the draft config."
+        )
+    if any(
+        not isinstance(layer_id, int) or isinstance(layer_id, bool)
+        for layer_id in target_layer_ids
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} target_layer_ids must contain only integers.")
+    if list(target_layer_ids) != sorted(set(target_layer_ids)):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} target_layer_ids must be unique and strictly increasing."
+        )
+    if target_layer_ids[0] < 0 or target_layer_ids[-1] >= target_num_layers:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} target_layer_ids must be zero-based text-layer indices in "
+            f"[0, {target_num_layers - 1}]; got {target_layer_ids}."
+        )
+
+    markov_rank = getattr(draft_hf_config, "markov_rank", None)
+    if (
+        not isinstance(markov_rank, int)
+        or isinstance(markov_rank, bool)
+        or markov_rank <= 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} requires a positive integer markov_rank in the draft config."
+        )
+    markov_head_type = getattr(draft_hf_config, "markov_head_type", None)
+    if markov_head_type != "vanilla":
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} currently requires markov_head_type='vanilla'; "
+            f"got {markov_head_type!r}."
+        )
+
+    sample_from_anchor = getattr(draft_hf_config, "sample_from_anchor", True)
+    bonus_anchor = getattr(draft_hf_config, "dspark_bonus_anchor", False)
+    if sample_from_anchor is not True or bonus_anchor is not False:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} requires sample_from_anchor=true and dspark_bonus_anchor=false."
+        )
+
+    draft_input_vocab_size = getattr(draft_hf_config, "vocab_size", None)
+    if (
+        not isinstance(draft_input_vocab_size, int)
+        or isinstance(draft_input_vocab_size, bool)
+        or draft_input_vocab_size <= 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} input vocab_size must be a positive integer; "
+            f"got {draft_input_vocab_size}."
+        )
+
+    noise_token_id = _get_nested_config_value(
+        draft_hf_config, "dflash_config", "mask_token_id"
+    )
+    for token_name in (
+        "mask_token_id",
+        "dspark_noise_token_id",
+        "pard_token",
+        "ptd_token_id",
+    ):
+        if noise_token_id is None:
+            noise_token_id = getattr(draft_hf_config, token_name, None)
+        if noise_token_id is not None:
+            break
+    if (
+        not isinstance(noise_token_id, int)
+        or isinstance(noise_token_id, bool)
+        or not 0 <= noise_token_id < draft_input_vocab_size
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name} requires a valid mask/noise token id within the draft input "
+            f"vocabulary [0, {draft_input_vocab_size - 1}]."
+        )
+    return block_size

inline_comments.body:
Thanks for the review and for pointing this out. My original intention was to support a wider D-Spark query block than the verified proposal prefix—for example, running an 8-position D-Spark forward while sampling 7 draft tokens, so target verification covers those 7 tokens plus the bonus token. This condition prevented the unused eighth query row from writing into the 7-token sampling buffers.
However, D-Spark can simply run with 7 query positions and verify the same 7+1 positions. There is no evidence that D8/Q7 performs better than D7/Q7, while maintaining separate draft and verification widths clearly introduces additional kernel and scheduler complexity. I therefore removed the Q/K decoupling and reverted this change.

Thanks for the review. Ling3.0 flash uses an MLA/KDA target with a dense MHA draft. KDA increases the target's
global attention block size, but applying the same token block size to the
dense draft produces a much larger MHA page and substantially reduces the
shared KV-cache capacity.

The Ling draft therefore uses a local 128-token KV-cache block. This override
is specific to normalized Ling D-Spark checkpoints; other Qwen3 DFlash and
D-Spark models continue to use the global cache block size.

I have updated the implementation and clarified the comment in the latest revision.
